note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MON 8; A06b MON 8; L05 MON 24(1)): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Montenegro, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Montenegro for 10 years uninterrupted immediately before the application. ... Renunciation or automatic loss of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires citizenship of another country. Provision does not apply when a dual citizenship agreement exists with that country. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Montenegro to a citizen. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to two citizens, or to one parent who is a citizen and another parent who is unknown, stateless or of unknown citizenship, or to one parent who is a citizen and the person would otherwise be stateless.; Person is born abroad to a citizen and the person does not hold citizenship of another country (by registration by parent before the age of 18).; Person is born abroad to a citizen (by declaration by person between the age of 18 and 23). ... No provision ... No provision
